I'd include the main absolute figures as facts, and maybe one qualitative item about generational wealth transfers contributing to outflows (that's relevant to the question of preparation and relates to retention).

Also preparation content: digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors (10K-2025#88); Financial Planning Services, High Net Worth, Workplace initiatives.
